narratives.narrative: Helios BioSystems limits information system access to authorized users through Microsoft 365 Business Premium with Azure AD Conditional Access policies. Three role tiers are enforced: Admin (Sarah Chen only), CUI Users (3 researchers), and Read-Only (1 project manager). Access requests require email approval from Sarah plus CEO sign-off for CUI-tier access. Quarterly access reviews are conducted, with the most recent completed on 2026-04-15. Evidence: E-AC-001 (Azure AD Conditional Access policy export), E-AC-002 (Q1 2026 access review log), E-AC-003 (employee onboarding/offboarding checklist).

All users authenticate to organizational systems via Azure AD with enforced password policies: minimum 12 characters, complexity requirements enabled, and 90-day rotation. Service accounts use managed identities with no interactive login capability. Authentication events are logged in Azure AD Sign-in Logs and retained for 90 days. The IT administrator reviews failed authentication attempts weekly. Evidence: E-IA-001 (Azure AD password policy screenshot), E-IA-002 (sign-in log sample from 2026-04-01).

Helios BioSystems does not currently enforce account lockout after unsuccessful login attempts. Windows workstations allow unlimited login attempts with no lockout policy configured in Azure AD Conditional Access or local Group Policy. This gap will be addressed via POA&M item POAM-001 by configuring Azure AD smart lockout with a threshold of 5 attempts and 15-minute lockout duration. Target completion: 2026-07-08. Evidence: E-AC-004 (current Azure AD sign-in policy showing no lockout), E-AC-005 (POA&M entry POAM-001).

Event log review is not systematically performed at Helios BioSystems. While M365 Unified Audit Logs capture events automatically, no staff member is assigned to review them on a regular schedule and no alerting is configured for anomalous activity. This gap will be remediated via POA&M item POAM-006 by establishing a weekly log review process using M365 alert policies and a documented review checklist. Target completion: 2026-08-19. Evidence: E-AU-001 (M365 audit log settings screenshot showing no alert policies), E-AU-002 (POA&M entry POAM-006).

Helios BioSystems encrypts CUI at rest using BitLocker (AES-256) on Windows laptops and FileVault on Mac, and in transit via Virtru for email and TLS 1.3 for M365 services. However, neither BitLocker nor Virtru operates in FIPS 140-2 validated mode, and the cryptographic modules are not on the CMVP validated modules list. This partial implementation will be remediated via POA&M item POAM-020 by enabling BitLocker FIPS mode via GPO and configuring FIPS-validated TLS modules. Target completion: 2026-10-28. Evidence: E-SC-001 (BitLocker status showing non-FIPS mode), E-SC-002 (Virtru configuration export), E-SC-003 (POA&M entry POAM-020).
